arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE transparent full-body cartoon sprite based on the FIRST image, an exact enlarged pixel-art pose. The SECOND image is ONLY the shared character identity/material/style reference, NOT its walking pose. Keep the source's exact facing, head angle, arm/hand positions and standing leg/foot silhouette. Same adult small worker: black cap, dark short hair, tan face/hands, bright green long-sleeve shirt, royal blue bib overalls, dark shoes; crisp black contour and clean cel shading, rounded natural anatomy. Do not trace pixel stairs. The standing feet/legs from the FIRST image must remain in their source stance, not the key's raised knee. Keep both hands and both feet. Match occlusion of head/arms rather than moving hands for visibility. True transparent RGBA background, no scenery, floor, shadows, halos, extra objects, text or duplicate figure. Leave about 5% transparent safety margin outside all contours.  Exactly TWO arms total, one left and one right, and exactly TWO hands total. Standing worker with head turned more TOWARD THE VIEWER than the side-profile key, both eyes naturally visible under the black cap, readable nose and mouth. One forearm/hand rests across the forehead/cap brim in lookout/salute, elbow bends outward at screen-right. His other single arm hangs beside the torso at screen-left with hand near hip. The hand can partially occlude upper brow but preserve visible face. Exactly two arms: one saluting and one hanging. Keep source's frontal head turn while body and two offset standing shoes stay slightly toward screen-right.
